textos.Muitas reviews descrevem o filme como ar: Many reviews describe the film as drawn out and boring, with scenes that go on excessively and a narrative that does not hold the attention.
textos.Diversos espectadores relatam dificuldad: Several viewers report difficulty following the story, feeling lost or not understanding what is happening on screen.
textos.O roteiro é criticado por parecer sem di: The script is criticized for seeming directionless, poorly adapted or for not developing an engaging plot, leaving the sense that nothing happens.
textos.O protagonista e os demais personagens s: The protagonist and the other characters are seen as apathetic, charmless or unbearable, making any emotional connection difficult.
textos.Fotografia e aspectos técnicos elogiados: Praised cinematography and technical aspects, but not enough
textos.Apesar de reconhecerem a beleza da fotog: Although acknowledging the beauty of the cinematography, production design and score, many state that these elements do not make up for the narrative problems.
textos.Espectadores mencionam não sentir nada p: Viewers mention feeling nothing for the film, remaining emotionally distant and indifferent to what is depicted.
textos.Ritmo lento e sensação de duração excess: Slow pace and sense of excessive length
textos.Diversas reviews medianas descrevem a ex: Several middling reviews describe the experience as drawn out, with long stretches of stagnation that make the film feel much longer than it really is, making the screening tiring.
textos.Fotografia, arte e som de alta qualidade: High-quality cinematography, art direction and sound
textos.Mesmo sem se envolver totalmente, várias: Even without being fully engaged, several people highlight the beauty of the images, the composition of the shots, the production design and the power of the sound as notable technical aspects.
textos.A interpretação do protagonista é freque: The lead's performance is frequently praised, with mentions of his ability to convey weariness, frustration and a melancholic presence that carries a good portion of the film.
textos.Muitas reviews medianas relatam que, ape: Many middling reviews report that, although they recognize the formal quality, they could not engage emotionally with the protagonist or the story, feeling held at a distance.
textos.Algumas pessoas apontam que o filme retr: Some people point out that the film satirically portrays the inefficiency of colonial administration, the absurdity of bureaucracy and power relations, although not always developing these themes in depth.
textos.Estrutura narrativa fragmentada e falta: Fragmented narrative structure and lack of conventional plot
textos.Há quem mencione que o roteiro se afasta: Some mention that the script departs from linear progression, with time jumps and events that seem disconnected, which generates confusion or disinterest in a portion of the audience.
textos.Várias reviews positivas comentam que o: Several positive reviews comment that the pace is deliberately slow and drawn out, creating a sense of agony and claustrophobia that matches the protagonist's experience, although some consider that this may make the film tiring at certain moments.
textos.As reviews elogiam a fotografia impressi: Reviews praise the impressive cinematography, the immersive sound design and the meticulous period re-creation, which transport the viewer to the eighteenth century and create a dense, sensory atmosphere.
textos.Este grupo destaca como o filme expõe o: This group highlights how the film exposes the absurdity and violence of the colonial system, portraying the Spanish bureaucracy as Kafkaesque and showing the hypocrisy of the colonizers, who treat the native peoples with contempt while depending on a central power that ignores them.
textos.Atuação e construção do protagonista: Performance and construction of the protagonist
textos.A atuação de Daniel Giménez Cacho é freq: Daniel Giménez Cacho's performance is frequently cited as superb, bringing to life a pathetic, frustrated character in mental decline, whose trajectory is at once tragic and ridiculous.
textos.Dificuldade de envolvimento emocional ou: Difficulty with emotional engagement or understanding
textos.Parte das reviews positivas admite que n: A portion of the positive reviews admit that they could not connect emotionally with the characters or fully understand the narrative on a first viewing, feeling disoriented, but still value the technical and thematic aspects.
textos.Alguns membros do grupo percebem o filme: Some members of the group see the film as an absurd black comedy, with subtle ironies and situations that border on the surreal, although they acknowledge that the humor is dry and may not please everyone.

textos.Dirigido por Lucrecia Martel e lançado e: Directed by Lucrecia Martel and released in 2017, Zama is a historical drama set in the late eighteenth century. The narrative follows Don Diego de Zama, a Spanish magistrate serving a punishment in Asunción while awaiting a transfer to Buenos Aires, later deciding to join an expedition in search of a legendary outlaw across distant lands.
textos.A obra estrutura sua experiência em um r: The work structures its experience in a measured, contemplative pace, relying on a historical setting marked by stagnation and sensory density.
textos.Na maioria das notas (~66%), uma parcela: In most of the ratings (~66%), a significant share stress the slow pace and the oppressive atmosphere as central elements of the approach. In addition, many emphasize the quality of the cinematography, sound and art direction, while several highlight the critical portrayal aimed at colonialism and bureaucracy.
textos.Nessa perspectiva, presente numa parcela: From this perspective, found in a share of the ratings (~25%), most report that the drawn-out pace causes a sense of excessive length. At the same time, a good portion acknowledge the technical value of the cinematography, art direction and sound, and a smaller slice underline Daniel Giménez Cacho's performance in the lead role.
textos.Para a visão expressa numa fração mínima: For the view expressed in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~9%), a large portion point to the slow pace and boredom as central points of discontent. In addition, a considerable number mention confusion and lack of understanding of the events, and a significant share criticize the script and the development of the narrative as weak.
